Hi everyone, 

Today I pushed an update fixing a nasty bug introduced in version 0.1.9 which was corrupting save files and causing various crashes in the game.
The big problem is that every save files made with the version 0.1.9 is corrupted and shouldn't be used because the bug can't be fixed retroactively.
I'm not sure everything is fixed so please tell me on the Steam forum or on Discord if you encounter other bugs with the new version on a fresh new game.

Have a good day !
Morm

notes.title: Demo 0.1.8 : Death is not the end
notes.content:
Based on your feedback and further testing on my part, I decided to make death in battle less punitive. On the other end, I hope it doesn't make the game too trivial. Feel free to tell me what you think about these changes.

[b]Patch notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Wound system : when a characters falls in combat, he now becomes wounded instead of dying immediately. Wounds reduce Max HP, heals over time, and can kill permanently the character if he has too much
[*]A new world site : the "Dark Church" which allows to resurrect dead characters for a fee
[*]A new Unlocks window on the main menu to keep track of the achievements
[*]As always, some various minor bug fixes and UX improvements
[/list]

Thanks and have a good day!

notes.title: Demo 0.1.6 : Unlock system
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thanks to your feedback, I made a new update for the demo of Mystical Conquests.

The main new feature is the "Unlock system", which allows to start a new game with different classes once they are unlocked. To unlock a class, you have to obtain (or train) a character with this class in a game at least once.

Here is the full changelog :

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Unlock system
[*]can delete save file
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes
[/b][list]
[*]battles in dwellings could freeze at the end
[*]bug with quests when clearing a dwelling before taking the quest
[*]a bug with the display of the rebind inputs
[*]the preview of the attack was not showing with Charge
[/list]
[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*]shortcut to run commands with 1/2/3/4/5/6/7/8/9 keys
[*]various UI improvements
[*]changed the color of the "night"
[/list]

Thanks and have a good day,
Morm

notes.title: Long Overdue Development Update
notes.content:
I'll start by saying that I'm sorry to have been silent for almost a year now and to not have released the demo last year like I said in the last update. But I finally have some new things to share about Mystical Conquests, I hope you'll enjoy it. If you don't want to read my ramblings and just want the useful informations, go straight to the last paragraph.

[h2]The Long Story[/h2]
When I started to do some heavy playtests last year for the release of the demo, I was not fully satisfied with the game. It was functional and had several hours of gameplay, but it lacked some elements to truly be the game I wanted to make : mainly, the combats were too simple and I really wanted to add some RPG aspects and a focus on characters, but none of the implementation that I tried was satisfying.

So I decided to take a small break from the game to take a step back and think about how to evolve it from there. I started to work on a small survival game to keep the creative juice flowing (I'll probably get back to it after MC). And one day, while playing some XCOM 2, it finally clicked, Mystical Conquests needed a tactical layer.

This change involved a lot of rework on the engine to have two distinct "layers", the world one and the battle one, so I started here. It also entailed a big shift in the scale of the game, the player now controls individual characters instead of groups of people. After working on all this for a few weeks, I felt really good about the first prototypes so I decided to keep going in this direction and double down on development. And here we are. I hope that you'll enjoy those changes.

[h2]The Good News[/h2]
First things first, I made a new trailer where you can see how the game evolved : 
[previewyoutube=vEFzKH6WGBs;full][/previewyoutube]
Secondly, the game is registered to participate in the Strategy Fest on Steam that will start on august 28, and the demo will finally be available for this event. I'll also release the demo earlier on itch.io to get some precious feedbacks in order to have the best possible build for the Fest, so check it if you want to help me improve the game.

Thanks a lot for reading this far, I'll try to keep you informed on a more regular basis from now on.
Morm
